title: IT Security weekly group assignments with disclosed ChatGPT use
summary: Groups of two or three students complete 11 or 12 weekly IT Security exercise sheets containing graded and optional tasks. ChatGPT is permitted, but students must identify its use and include the prompt; an incorrect ChatGPT-assisted answer earns zero for the entire task.

sources.title: Assessing the Impact of Large Language Models on Cybersecurity Education: A Study of ChatGPT's Influence on Student Performance
sources.evidence_quote: Students are permitted to use it, but they must indicate this on their submissions, including the leveraged prompt.

purpose_and_stakes.pass_requirement: Achieve 50% of graded-task points and present two solutions to qualify for the final exam.

assessment.summary: Complete weekly IT Security exercise sheets in a small group and disclose any ChatGPT assistance and prompts.
student_actions: Submit group answers and present two solutions.

outputs.artifact: ChatGPT-use disclosure and prompts when used

student_role.description: ChatGPT is permitted under a mandatory disclosure and prompt-reporting policy.

grading.method: Tutors grade two required tasks per sheet; each task is worth 10 points. An incorrect ChatGPT-assisted answer receives zero for the whole task.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.
